verdict.rationale: CoreWeave AI Object Storage supports bucket lifecycle policies with Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload actions, plus bucket cleanup. Users can also manage and delete objects from the Cloud Console and delete clusters via the API. This gives real customer-controlled retention and deletion for stored data, but the evidence is limited to a changelog note and covers object storage only. missing for 10: provider-side data retention and deletion commitments (e.g. post-account-closure or log/telemetry retention), deletion guarantees or verification, retention controls beyond object storage (e.g. inference request data), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
